en: Render and GitHub take part in the EU–U.S. Data Privacy Framework, which the European Commission has recognised as providing an adequate level of protection.
target: Render y GitHub participan en el Marco de Privacidad de Datos UE-EE. UU. (EU–U.S. Data Privacy Framework), para el que la Comisión Europea ha reconocido un nivel de protección adecuado.
suggestion: Render y GitHub participan en el Marco de Privacidad de Datos UE-EE. UU. (EU–U.S. Data Privacy Framework), que la Comisión Europea ha reconocido como garante de un nivel de protección adecuado.
explanation: Accuracy nuance (rule 1): the English says the Commission recognised the Framework AS PROVIDING adequate protection; «para el que … ha reconocido un nivel» reads as a level recognised «for» the Framework and blurs who provides the protection. The suggestion restores the «recognised as providing» relation without adding anything. The meaning is broadly kept, so this is a nuance, not a factual change.
rule: fidelity: relation in the source kept
